unsupported_shapes.shape: Historical scanned or glyph-dependent member grid
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Edition, capture identity and independently checked literal observations.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Complete tabular extraction until the historical layout has visual fixtures and reconciliation.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Review every grid page, symbols and footnotes; establish source-defined membership.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Peer-relative or incompletely specified composite scoring
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Published metrics, component relationships, stated weights and methodology version.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Reproduction without the reference population, all inputs and exact transformation rules.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Acquire the edition's complete component/member data and the peer comparison rule.

unsupported_shapes.preserve: Score, grade, rank and exclusion notes as separate source facts.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Reproduction from the sampled final ratings without the complete item-weight and participation inputs.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Acquire the edition's vote list, weights, grade thresholds and member eligibility.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Qualitative grades using undisclosed member-level inputs
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Literal published grade and stated criteria; permit an edition with no disclosed items.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Inventing an item ledger, point conversion or official-action comparison for inaccessible activity.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Only add item facts if the publisher supplies them; otherwise retain a published-rating-only source.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Signed contributions, multiple periods and cohort-specific grades
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Literal contributions, edition periods, methodology scope and final values.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Reproduction until the underlying member-item data, cohort assignments and complete rules are acquired.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Acquire the publisher's Data Annex or equivalent item/member ledger.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Dynamic embedded member grid with mutable chamber-specific methodology
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Methodology snapshots, literal tier boundaries, weights and publisher-designated actions.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Complete rating ingestion from a shell response; repairing tier ranges or inferring missing rows.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Capture the publisher-authorized embedded dataset with a coherent snapshot and proven end condition.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Aggregate index result without an inspected methodology or item ledger
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Signed decimals and ranks exactly as printed.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Preferred-action inference, cross-publisher numeric comparisons and score reproduction.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Inspect the original methodology and its edition-specific inputs.

unsupported_shapes.shape: ADA 1947 scanned member grid without checked cells
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Edition identity, source capture and observed scanned layout.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Full historical table extraction until visual row/cell fixtures and source counts qualify.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Inspect all historical member-grid pages and reconcile glyphs, footnotes and membership.

unsupported_shapes.shape: Repeated source column labels without an established action crosswalk
unsupported_shapes.preserve: Distinct literal workbook columns and independently identified dated item pages.
unsupported_shapes.unsupported: Assigning duplicated H.R.4 workbook result columns to dated item URLs without direct linkage or a uniquely verified complete outcome crosswalk.
unsupported_shapes.next_evidence: Establish exact source-backed column-to-item mapping, then version and test its ambiguity refusal.

hunt.decision: A bill citation does not require a roll-call link.
Preserve distinct action types and sponsorship multipliers.
Retain the stated criterion; no committee roll call is fabricated from a floor-vote table.
H.R. 2670 appears in several amendment items and final passage. Key by publisher item, never by bill alone.
The action and target apply to the particular motion; supporting a bill need not mean supporting every motion.
Keep publisher absence/exclusion rules and source glyphs separately from official voting status.
Allow non-vote actions and source-attributed leadership marks.
Preserve 100+ and leader symbols; no invented numeric total.
Keep signed contributions; they are not automatically negative weights.
Keep this hunt open. Signed contributions do not prove a negative multiplier.
Printed pages 10–11 credit a procedural no vote according to HRC's explanation; preserve publisher judgment separately from the official no.
Represent metric-to-metric components; an item-to-metric table alone is insufficient.
Store the grade as text with a grade unit; no numeric conversion.
Give each metric its period; the survey does not establish one edition with all three forms.
Methodology scope includes chamber and member cohort.
Eligibility belongs at member/item/metric scope, with a source-stated reason.
Final ratings remain usable source facts; detailed analysis stays explicitly unsupported.

hunt.disposition: Represent item targets and member-item results without a metric; proposal-0.2 resolves C-M01.
